naslov: OpenAI is poaching Anthropic's biggest customers with discounts of up to 90%
opis:
According to The Information, OpenAI is offering steep discounts to companies that use Claude. Replit got more than 30% off a contract worth over $100 million a year, and DataCamp's CEO says their costs fell by 80 to 90%.

Why it matters: A price war means it's worth re-comparing model prices every couple of months, even for a small project.

naslov: Anthropic: one agent beats a pile of subagents
opis:
Anthropic is advising teams to check whether they can merge multiple subagents (helper agents the main agent hands work to) into a single agent. That agent would load skills, tools and knowledge on its own, as it needs them. In one comparison, such a system ran about twice as fast.

Why it matters: If you build agent chains in Claude Code or your own app, a simpler system is probably both faster and cheaper.

naslov: Anthropic's OSS Scanner: first results from free open-source scanning
opis:
Anthropic is offering a free vulnerability scanner for important open-source projects, running on its strongest models, including Claude Mythos. Of about 650 applications, 114 projects were accepted. In 11 days the model rated 77 findings as critical and 803 as high.

Why it matters: The libraries your Angular and Supabase apps depend on will likely ship security patches more often in the coming weeks.

naslov: Try Hallmark: A skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode that builds web pages that…
opis:
A skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and OpenCode that builds web pages that don't look like typical AI design.

How to try it:
1. In a terminal (needs Node 18+): npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g --agent claude-code
2. In Claude Code, type /hallmark build a landing page for ...
3. For an existing project: /hallmark audit ./index.html (check only) or /hallmark redesign ./src/app
4. For browser checks, install npm i -g puppeteer-core (you'll also need Chrome)

Price: free (MIT)

Official link: https://github.com/Nutlope/hallmark

naslov: AI app idea: Does your site look AI-made? – Many small-business websites are now built with AI…
opis:
Does your site look AI-made?: Many small-business websites are now built with AI and all look alike, which comes across as cheap work.

Who it is for: Freelance web designers and small businesses in Serbia that want a site that doesn't look templated

How AI helps: The Hallmark lint checks the page, and a model explains in Serbian exactly what gives away the AI look and suggests three concrete changes.

First steps:
1. Install Hallmark and run sloplint.mjs --render on a few well-known sites to see what kind of report it produces
2. Build an Angular page with a single URL field and a Supabase Edge Function that runs the check
3. Send the result to Claude and ask it to retell it for a business owner, without technical jargon
4. Add a score from 1 to 10 and a share button, as a lead magnet for clients

Difficulty: 2/5 · weekend project
